rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for unpleasant, tedious work or chores.

example.english: This job is real drudgery; I have to do the same thing every day.
example.traditional: 呢份工真係苦差事，日日都要重複做同一樣嘢。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 fu2 caai1 si6 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 cung4 fuk1 zou6 tung4 jat1 joeng6 je5

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the drudgery is physically demanding manual work.

example.english: Leave this kind of heavy manual drudgery to us.
example.traditional: 搬貨呢啲粗重嘢，留返畀我哋做啦。
example.jyutping: bun1 fo3 ne1 di1 cou1 cung5 je5 lau4 faan2 bei2 ngo5 dei6 zou6 laa1

rows.note: Use this for routine miscellaneous duties, especially menial office or household tasks, without necessarily stressing physical exhaustion.

example.english: I'm always tied up with drudgery and can't get to my real work.
example.traditional: 我成日畀啲雜務纏住，做唔到正經工作。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 bei2 di1 zaap6 mou6 cin4 zyu6 zou6 m4 dou3 zing3 ging1 gung1 zok3
